parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US (default): English.

parameters.name: AddressPoolId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the address pool.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.
